clauses.reason: Terminated by own terms: 'until March 31, 1935' (stated date inclusive, 1935-03-31; exclusive reading one day earlier). Actor EO:6088 itself. Later events: new 'further exemption' grants of the same person, each with its own date and quote; none revokes or amends this order.

research_rationale:
EO:6088 (1933-03-29) is a single-clause order under section 204 of the Economy Act of June 30, 1932 exempting Harry O. Bailey, superintendent of meters, Office of the Architect of the Capitol from compulsory retirement for age and continuing the person in the service 'until March 31, 1935'. The order ends by its own terms on 1935-03-31 (stated date, inclusive; exclusive alternative one day earlier, per the owner's 2026-10-21 ruling on 'until' dates). Later orders in the same person's exemption chain, read in the packet: EO:6998 (1935-03-30); EO:7597 (1937-03-31); each is recorded as a later event with its own date and quote (owner ruling, 2026-10-21), and none revokes, amends or shortens this order. The OFR catalog's disposition note on EO 7597 (1937 onward) calls the later order an amendment of this one; read against the texts, EO 7597 grants a new exemption and amends nothing in this order, whose term had already run out on 1935-03-31. The dossier's machine term leads were read against the text; the operative until-date in the command sentence is the end. @rationale:retirement:statute @rationale:retirement:search @rationale:retirement:inventory
